name: Typing speed test
title: Typing Speed Test: Check Your WPM and Accuracy
description: Test your typing speed in words per minute with common English words. Choose 15 seconds to 2 minutes, see your accuracy and beat your best.
summary: Words per minute and accuracy in 15 seconds to 2 minutes.
howTo: Pick a length, from 15 seconds to 2 minutes. Tick Punctuation and capitals for a harder test.
Click the box and start typing the words shown. The clock starts with your first letter. Press <kbd>Space</kbd> after each word; a word turns red if it doesn’t match.
When time runs out you get your words per minute, accuracy and the words you missed. Your best score for each length stays in this browser.

faq.a: By the usual standard: every 5 correctly typed characters, spaces included, count as one word. Wrong words don’t count, so the score rewards accuracy as well as speed. Raw WPM includes everything you typed.
Around 40 WPM is typical for adults who type every day. 60 or more is fast, and professional typists often reach 80 to 100.
The share of keys you pressed that were right at the time. Fixing a typo with Backspace helps the word but still counts the wrong key.
Pasting would make the score meaningless, so it’s turned off in the typing box.
